# Keep one tab stop in the Calendar view tablist

The day, week, multiweek, and month view controls form one tablist. The selected tab has tabindex 0 and the others have -1, so keyboard users reach the tablist once and move within it using its key handling.

Scope: calendar-accessibility.

Paths:

- `calendar/base/content/calendar-tab-panels.inc.xhtml`

[Shared lesson record](../records/b19e87b7087343fd2e6855f2b5978014ba4a8087259351080b1241dc4ff919ae.json).
